YARIN DA DEVAM EDECEK Ailelerin ve dostların bir araya geldiği etkinlik, sıcak sohbet ortamı ve çeşitli lezzetleriyle Viyana’daki ziyaretçilerini ağırlamayı sürdürüyor. Üç gün sürecek organizasyon, 11 Ekim Pazar günü de saat 09.00 ile 21.00 arasında ziyaret edilebilecek. Erkekler bölümü Mescidi Ebubekir’de (Koppstraße 39), kadınlar bölümü ise Semerkand Dergâhı’nda (Koppstraße 41) hizmet veriyor. Hayra Davet Wien yetkilileri, tüm dostları ve aileleri etkinliğin son gününde de bu güzel buluşmaya katılmaya davet ediyor. 📍 Adres: Koppstraße 39-41, 1160 Wien 📞 İletişim: +43 660 6279181

candidateAudit.title: 🟡 Zu viel im Kopf schlägt auf den Magen. In der TCM ist das keine Redensart. Die Milz, so die Traditionelle Chinesische Medizin, verdaut nicht nur Essen, sondern auch Gedanken und
candidateAudit.text: 🟡 Zu viel im Kopf schlägt auf den Magen. In der TCM ist das keine Redensart. Die Milz, so die Traditionelle Chinesische Medizin, verdaut nicht nur Essen, sondern auch Gedanken und Eindrücke. Deshalb sitzt dauerndes Grübeln oft genau dort, wo wir es am wenigsten vermuten: in der Mitte, im Bauch, in der Verdauung. Milz und Magen bilden zusammen das Erdelement - unser Zentrum. Sie verwandeln, was wir aufnehmen, in Kraft und geben uns Halt. Steht die Mitte stabil, fühlen wir uns genährt und klar. Gerät sie aus dem Takt, wird alles schwer: der Bauch, die Gedanken, der Tag. Das Erdelement wird dem Spätsommer zugeordnet - dem ruhigen Moment zwischen den Jahreszeiten, in dem nichts drängt und alles reift. Ein kleiner Impuls: Iss heute eine Mahlzeit im Sitzen, ohne Bildschirm. Schmeckt besser. Und deine Milz liebt nichts so sehr wie Ruhe und Rhythmus. Was fällt dir gerade schwerer - dich wirklich zu nähren oder das Grübeln loszulassen? Schreib’s uns in die Kommentare. 🤗 #dancingshivavienna #tcm #meridiane #erdelement #vitalpilze

candidateAudit.text: Unsere Küche beginnt lange vor dem Anrichten. Mit dem, was aus dem Gemüsekorb kommt: Wer bei uns in der Küche steht, sucht die Ware aus, putzt, schneidet, legt ein – und richtet erst dann an. Fast alles entsteht im Haus, vom Brot bis zum Eingelegten. Viele im Team sind seit Jahren dabei, und Sonn- und Feiertage hast du frei. Wir suchen Verstärkung: Chef de Rang ab 2.500 €, Chef de Partie ab 2.700 € und einen Operativen Eventkoordinator für den Saal ab 2.600 € (alle drei Vollzeit, Überzahlung je nach Erfahrung) sowie Lehrlinge für Küche oder Service mit 1.090 € im 1. bis 1.550 € im 4. Lehrjahr laut Kollektivvertrag, jeweils brutto im Monat, alle m/w/d. Bewirb dich formlos an thomas.hahn@labstelle.at oder über den Link im Profil. Lebenslauf keine Pflicht. — Our kitchen starts long before plating. It starts with what comes out of the vegetable basket: in our kitchen you choose the produce, clean, cut and preserve – and only then plate. Almost everything here is made in-house, from bread to pickles. Many on the team have been here for years, and Sundays and public holidays are off. We are hiring in Vienna: Chef de Rang from €2,500, Chef de Partie from €2,700 and an event coordinator (operations) for the Saal from €2,600 (all three full-time, more depending on experience), plus apprentices for kitchen or service at €1,090 in the first to €1,550 in the fourth year, all gross per month, all m/f/d. Apply informally at thomas.hahn@labstelle.at or via the link in our bio. No CV required. #labstellenwert #gastrojobswien #kochjobwien #chefdepartie #chefderang

candidateAudit.text: Profisportler und High Performer nutzen die Druckkammer längst. Die Frage ist, warum du noch wartest. In der hyperbaren Sauerstofftherapie atmest du reinen Sauerstoff unter erhöhtem Druck. Dadurch löst sich ein Vielfaches mehr davon direkt in deinem Blutplasma und erreicht auch Bereiche, an die rote Blutkörperchen kaum herankommen. Genau deshalb schwören Spitzensportler darauf. Ihr Körper regeneriert schneller, Entzündungen gehen zurück und die Leistungsfähigkeit steigt. Und das Beste: Diese Vorteile gelten nicht nur für Athleten. Dein Körper reagiert genauso. Es bilden sich neue, feine Blutgefäße, körpereigene Stammzellen werden aktiviert und oxidativer Stress wird gebremst. Das spürst du als mehr Energie, bessere Regeneration und eine Heilung von innen heraus. Swipe dich durch und sieh, was in deinem Körper passiert. Jetzt ist der beste Moment, es selbst zu erleben. Bis 12.10. bekommst du 20 Prozent auf deine HBOT Sessions. Sichere dir deinen Platz über den Link in unserer Bio. . . . #longevitycentervienna #biohackingvienna #hbot #sauerstofftherapie #performance

candidateAudit.text: Wo Geschichte lebendig bleibt.✨ Ein Abend voller Begegnungen, gelebter Tradition und besonderer Momente. Zwischen barocker Eleganz, musikalischen Darbietungen und festlichen Tanzmomenten wurde mit dem Eröffnungsball ein neues Kapitel für das Palais Coburg aufgeschlagen. Von den prachtvollen Salons bis in die historischen Kasematten wurde Geschichte spürbar und zugleich der Grundstein für all jene Geschichten gelegt, die hier künftig weitergeschrieben werden. Ein Abend, der den Zauber des Palais Coburg auf besondere Weise erlebbar gemacht hat. **************************************** Where history comes alive.✨ An evening full of encounters, living tradition and special moments. Amidst Baroque elegance, musical performances and festive dancing, the opening ball marked the start of a new chapter for the Palais Coburg. From the magnificent salons right through to the historic casemates, history was palpable, whilst at the same time the foundation was laid for all those stories that will continue to be written here in the future. An evening that brought the magic of the Palais Coburg to life in a very special way. 📸tony.gigov #PalaisCoburg #PalaisCoburgVienna #Eröffnungsball #ViennaEvents #HistoricElegance #LuxuryHospitality #PrivateGuesthouse #ViennaLifestyle #OpeningNight #FineLiving #MomentsThatMatter #PalaisCoburgMoments

candidateAudit.title: “Da hätte ich früher mit Wut reagiert. Jetzt bleibe ich einfach gelassen.” Das hören wir fast nach jeden 10er Block Neurofeedback. Wichtig vorweg: Wie dein Gehirn auf Stress reagie
candidateAudit.text: “Da hätte ich früher mit Wut reagiert. Jetzt bleibe ich einfach gelassen.” Das hören wir fast nach jeden 10er Block Neurofeedback. Wichtig vorweg: Wie dein Gehirn auf Stress reagiert, ist oft einfach Persönlichkeit und keine krankhafte Veränderung. Es geht um Regulation, nicht um Diagnosen. Beim Neurofeedback lernt dein Gehirn, sich selbst besser zu regulieren. Es bekommt in Echtzeit Rückmeldung über seine eigene Aktivität und trainiert so, aus überreizten Mustern auszusteigen. Das Spannende: Viele Menschen spüren den Unterschied schon nach der zweiten, dritten oder vierten Sitzung. Situationen, die früher Wut oder Stress ausgelöst hätten, lassen sie plötzlich gelassen. Nicht weil sie sich zusammenreißen, sondern weil das Nervensystem anders reagiert. Gelassenheit ist trainierbar. Und dein Gehirn lernt schneller, als du denkst. Kennst du Situationen, in denen du gerne gelassener reagieren würdest? Schreib es in die Kommentare. . . . #longevitycentervienna #biohackingvienna #longevityaustria #neurofeedback #gehirntraining

candidateAudit.text: Mitarbeiter des Monats September Wie jeden ersten Sonntag im Monat, haben wir auch diesmal wieder unsere engagierten Service- und Küchenmitarbeiter geehrt. Gewählt wurden aus dem Küchenteam Dara Blecic und aus dem Serviceteam Vladiszlav Ivancso. Dara verstärkt unser Küchenteam bereits seit drei Jahren in der Vorbereitung und ist zusätzlich auch in der Wäscherei mit vollem Einsatz tätig. Ihre Flexibilität, ihre außergewöhnliche Gründlichkeit und ihr Fleiß leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zu den reibungslosen Abläufen in unserer Küche. Besonders geschätzt werden von ihren Kolleginnen und Kollegen aber auch ihre herzliche Art und ihr großes Herz. Vladiszlav ist seit 2024 Teil des Schweizerhaus-Teams und begeistert uns mit seinem großartigen Einsatz als Kellner. Als echter Teamplayer ist er aus unserem Service nicht mehr wegzudenken. Eigentlich war sein Traum, Profifußballer zu werden. Zum Glück hat er sich schließlich für das Schweizerhaus entschieden, wo er die schweren Tabletts mit einer Leichtigkeit und Sicherheit stemmt. Wir schätzen seine professionelle Einstellung, seine hohe Belastbarkeit und ganz besonders seine Zuverlässigkeit. Liebe Dara, lieber Vladiszlav, herzlichen Glückwunsch zur Auszeichnung und vielen Dank für Euren großartigen Einsatz. Wir freuen uns, Euch im Team zu haben! Eure Familie Karl Kolarik

candidateAudit.title: In Gedenken an Klaus Rader 🕊️ Wir sind tief geschockt und unendlich traurig über den tragischen Unfalltod von Klaus Rader. Klaus war ein Mensch, der andere mit seiner Energie, sei
candidateAudit.text: In Gedenken an Klaus Rader 🕊️ Wir sind tief geschockt und unendlich traurig über den tragischen Unfalltod von Klaus Rader. Klaus war ein Mensch, der andere mit seiner Energie, seiner Klarheit und seiner Leidenschaft bewegt und inspiriert hat. Für viele bei L’Osteria war er nicht nur Mitgründer und Gesellschafter, sondern ein Wegbegleiter, Freund und Vertrauter. Er war ein Menschenfreund und so stand der Mensch für ihn stets im Mittelpunkt seines unternehmerischen Wirkens. Sein Beitrag zu L’Osteria – und zu den vielen Menschen, die mit ihm arbeiten durften – ist kaum in Worte zu fassen. In einem kleinen Restaurant in Nürnberg legte er 1999 mit Friedemann Findeis, seinen Freund und Mitgründer, den Grundstein für L’Osteria. Aus dieser ersten L’Osteria entstand in über 25 Jahren eine europäische Gastronomiemarke, die heute Menschen in mehreren Ländern zusammenbringt und systemweit rund 10.000 Mitarbeitende aus über 110 Nationen verbindet. Klaus zeigte, dass Wachstum und Nähe kein Widerspruch sein müssen: dass ein Restaurantkonzept über Grenzen hinweg wachsen kann, ohne seinen Charakter zu verlieren. Grosse Pizzen zum Teilen, frische Pasta, offene Küchen und das Schaffen eines Ortes, an dem sich Menschen willkommen fühlen, sowie die gelebte LA FAMIGLIA-Kultur wurden zu prägenden Elementen von L’Osteria. Auch als Gesellschafter blieb Klaus L’Osteria eng verbunden. Mit seinem Mut, seinem klaren Blick und seiner besonderen Art, Menschen für gemeinsame Ideen zu begeistern, hat er unser Unternehmen nachhaltig mitgestaltet. Mit Klaus verlieren wir einen prägenden Teil unserer L’Oster

candidateAudit.title: Avusturya’da elektrikli otomobiller atağa geçti: Benzinli ve dizelleri geride bıraktı Avusturya’da otomobil pazarındaki dönüşüm hızlandı. Statistik Austria’nın eylül ayı verilerine
candidateAudit.text: Avusturya’da elektrikli otomobiller atağa geçti: Benzinli ve dizelleri geride bıraktı Avusturya’da otomobil pazarındaki dönüşüm hızlandı. Statistik Austria’nın eylül ayı verilerine göre, tam elektrikli otomobillerin yeni kayıt sayısı benzinli ve dizel otomobillerin toplamını geçti. Eylül ayında Avusturya genelinde 28.968 yeni otomobil trafiğe kaydedildi. Bu rakam geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 12,5 artış anlamına geliyor. Elektrikli otomobillerde yüzde 80,6 artış Ay içerisinde 9.723 tamamen elektrikli otomobil yeni kayıt yaptırdı. Elektrikli araçlardaki artış geçen yılın aynı ayına göre yüzde 80,6 oldu. Buna karşılık 6.727 benzinli ve 1.833 dizel otomobil kaydedildi. Böylece klasik benzinli ve dizel araçların toplamı 8.560 seviyesinde kaldı. Benzinli otomobillerin yeni kayıtları yüzde 12,1, dizellerinki ise yüzde 28,2 geriledi. Hibritler hâlâ güçlü Benzin-hibrit otomobillerde eylül ayında 9.917 yeni kayıt yapıldı ve yıllık bazda yüzde 11,2 artış görüldü. Dizel-hibritlerde ise tablo tersine döndü. 718 yeni araçla bu kategoride kayıtlar yüzde 38,2 azaldı. Alternatif motor sistemine sahip otomobillerin toplam yeni kayıt sayısı 20.358’e ulaşırken, yıllık artış yüzde 31,6 olarak kaydedildi. Motosiklet satışlarında da yükseliş Eylül ayında tüm motorlu taşıtlarda toplam 37.510 yeni kayıt gerçekleştirildi. Bu rakam geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 9,5 daha yüksek. Motosikletlerde de artış yaşandı. L3e sınıfında 2.723 yeni kayıtla yüzde 15,2, 50 cc mopedlerin yer aldığı L1e sınıfında ise 972 kayıtla yüzde 24,8 artış kaydedildi.

candidateAudit.text: 🚨 Fast 6 Stunden Verspätung! Ryanair FR 12 von Barcelona nach Wien ist gestern (4.10.) statt um 08:10 erst gegen 14:08 Uhr in Wien-Schwechat gelandet – rund +5:58 Stunden. ✈️ Warst du an Bord? Dann solltest du deine Rechte kennen: 1⃣ BETREUUNG – GILT IMMER Ab 2 Stunden Wartezeit: Mahlzeiten & Getränke, dazu 2 Telefonate oder E-Mails – egal, warum sich der Flug verspätet (Art. 9 EU-Fluggastrechte-VO 261/2004). Ninja-Tipp: Belege aufheben, falls die Airline vor Ort nichts anbietet! 2⃣ AB 5 STUNDEN: GELD ZURÜCK MÖGLICH Bei über 5 Stunden Verspätung kannst du vom Flug zurücktreten und dir den vollen Ticketpreis erstatten lassen (Art. 6 iVm Art. 8). 3⃣ ENTSCHÄDIGUNG: BIS ZU 250 € PRO PERSON MÖGLICH Ab 3 Stunden Verspätung am Endziel gibt's nach der Rechtsprechung des EuGH (Sturgeon) grundsätzlich eine Ausgleichszahlung – bei Barcelona–Wien (ca. 1.370 km) sind das 250 € pro Person. ❗ Ehrlich gesagt: Der Grund der Verspätung ist nicht offiziell bestätigt – am Wochenende gab es schwere Unwetter in Barcelona. Unwetter kann ein „außergewöhnlicher Umstand" sein, der die Entschädigung (nicht aber Betreuung & Erstattung!) entfallen lässt. Aber: Beweisen muss das die Airline – und auch zeigen, dass sie alles Zumutbare getan hat. Genau deshalb lohnt sich die Prüfung. Und das Beste: Die Entschädigung gibt's ZUSÄTZLICH zu Erstattung oder Ersatzbeförderung – sie ersetzt dein Ticket nicht. 👉 Prüf deinen Anspruch kostenlos in 2 Minuten auf flugninja.at – 100 % risikofrei, keine Vorkosten. candidateAudit.text: Thanks for joining the opening of the exhibition ‘03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ this week! At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphor. — on till 5 Nov 2026 Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 The exhibition emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) Next guided tours: 15 Oct, 16:00–18:00 Guided Tour and Soil Session with Christian Prohammer 21 Oct, 16:00—18:00 Guided Tour and Soil Session with Christian Prohammer 5 Nov 12:00—13:00 Guided Tour 13:15—15:30 Workshop with Franziska Allerberger Out of Balance: On the Quest for Reconnecting (Register via this link) Photos: Hannah Mayr _hannahmayr_ The project 03: Soil is generously supported by ÖAW. oeaw.at

candidateAudit.text: Außen goldbraun und knusprig gebraten, innen schmelzender Käse, zartes Hühnchen und cremige Avocado. 🥑🧀 Quesadillas sind die Antwort auf die Frage, wie man aus wenigen Zutaten ein echtes Comfort-Food-Highlight zaubert. Zutaten | Santa Maria Tortilla Large | Santa Maria Chunky Salsa Medium | 300 g gegartes Hühnerfleisch (gezupft oder gewürfelt) | 1 reife Avocado | Frühlingszwiebeln | Käse (z.B. Cheddar oder Mozzarella) | Etwas Öl oder Butter Zubereitung Zuerst das gewürzte Hühnerfleisch im Backofen ca. 20–25 Minuten bei 160–180 °C garen. Währenddessen die Frühlingszwiebel und die Avocado in Streifen schneiden und den Käse reiben. Sobald das Hühnerfleisch fertig gegart ist, eine Santa Maria Tortilla flach auslegen und eine Hälfte mit geriebenem Käse, Hühnerfleisch, Avocadoscheiben und Frühlingszwiebeln belegen. Die andere Hälfte darüberklappen, sodass ein Halbkreis entsteht. Die Quesadilla in einer Pfanne mit etwas Öl oder Butter bei mittlerer Hitze von beiden Seiten goldbraun anbraten, bis der Käse geschmolzen ist. In Dreiecke schneiden und heiß mit der Santa Maria Chunky Salsa zum Dippen servieren. 🤤 #santamaria #santamariamoment

candidateAudit.title: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive na
candidateAudit.text: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive narrative obscures a deeper, more ‘errant’ truth? Media theorist and author Clemens Apprich in conversation with philosopher Jan Völker. Moderated by Amanda Holmes, Department of Philosophy, University of Applied Arts Vienna Welcome: Ulrike Kuch, Rector of the University of Applied Arts Vienna A cooperation of the department of Media Theory and the department of Philosophy. ‘Errant Intelligence’ challenges the prevailing biological and individualistic interpretations of machine learning, arguing instead for a radical understanding of machine intelligence. The book embraces the deviations, inconsistencies, and ‘errant behaviour’ as fundamental to the discovery of new knowledge, moving beyond the illusion of mere optimisation. Drawing on media theory, cybernetics, and a unique psychoanalytic lens, it explores the ‘technological unconscious’ of machine learning. It traces the historical roots of AI, from early automatons and the Turing machine to natural language processing and contemporary machine learning systems. Challenging the idea of an autonomous, self-generating AI, the book exposes the hidden labour, assumed logics, and inherent biases that animate its operation. It re-evaluates computational thinking, insisting on its inherently social, collective, and symbolic character, and revealing how language and logical paradoxes are not obstacles but constitutive forces that shape intelligent machines

candidateAudit.text: In this workshop with Helena Detsch we will explore simple ways to create a fascinating natural color palette from soil and plant-based materials like earths, minerals, vegetables, kitchen supplies and algae pigments. In her oil paintings, installations and animations, Helena Detsch explores (mis-)relationships between humans and more-than-human life. candidateAudit.title: About the next exhibition at AIL: Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and sever
candidateAudit.text: About the next exhibition at AIL: Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. What is happening beneath our feet? At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). Join the extended exhibition program: 6 Oct Exhibition Opening with Performances by Michael Bahn, Johanna Unterpertinger and Christian Prohammer 8 Oct 15:30–17:30 Workshop with Helena Detsch The Organic Painter – Painting

candidateAudit.text: We keep on digging and the next artistic research exhibition will open in October – Save the date and join us! Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) Opening Program, 6 Oct 18:00 Welcome by Julienne Lorz expanded_museum_studies (Expanded Museum Studies, AIL Executive Board) and introduction by Soil team members 19:00 Soil rememb

candidateAudit.text: Wärmend, nährend und perfekt für kühler werdende Tage. 🧆🍂 Wenn die Tage kürzer werden, schreit der Magen nach echten Wohlfühl-Gerichten. Die angebratenen Meatballs hineingeben und in der wärmenden Tomatensauce leicht köcheln lassen, bis sie durchgegart sind. Die Gurken in Stifte schneiden und die Kirschtomaten halbieren. candidateAudit.title: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Appli
candidateAudit.text: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Applied Photography and Time-Based Media at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, which explores the synergistic potential of student teams from different degree programs. In collaboration with the department Industrial Design, this year’s focus was on the intersection of photography and the object, with particular attention paid to the relationship with set design, styling, casting and narrative. Seen from the perspective of Applied Photography, the object and thus the chair, is a welcome protagonist. Photography’s multiple applied genres are cited here: documentary, fashion, advertising, architecture and the portrait. When the function in Industrial Design coalesces with the idea of the purpose in Applied Photography, the question of factuality emerges. Be not mistaken: The most literal things are often the most confusing and enigmatic. Between what it is and how it is*, worlds unfold. We put the images to work. VDW Cocktail: 29 Sep, 17:00–18:00 Showcase and drinks followed by a collective walk to the billboards in front of the main entrance of the University Open Saturdays: 26 Sep / 3 Oct, 11:00–18:00 Opening hours: Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna The collaborative works are on display at the AIL and on the billboards at the university’s main entrance on Oskar-Kokoschka-Platz. dieangewandte viennadesignweek applied.photography angewandte_id Feat

candidateAudit.text: The Dinner Club by cicciosultano1 returned for another unforgettable evening, guided by the Art of Taste. For one night, barvinskyigallery transformed the Presidential Suite at The ritzcarltonvienna into an intimate presentation of contemporary art. Centred around the paintings of Sicilian artist Alessandro Florio, the evening became an ode to the island - from canvas to plate, where colours, flavours and stories came together. At the heart of it all, a table set for discovery. A place where strangers became friends, glasses were raised, stories were shared and every course offered another reason to linger a little longer. A celebration of Sicilian art, cuisine and the dolce vita, the way it should be enjoyed: together.

candidateAudit.text: 💘 Friends? Dates? Flirting? Something in between? Meet queer people in Vienna without swiping. 📅 Sat, 26 September 2026 ⏰ 19:00–21:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟️ €20 per person · cash at the door 💛 Soli tickets available 📝 Registration required 🌈 Who is it for? Queer people who want to meet other queer people — whether you’re looking for dating, friendship, flirting, new connections, or simply meeting more of the community. You’ll meet multiple people through a series of short mini-dates. Privately note who you’d like to connect with again — romantically, platonically, or otherwise. If you both choose each other, it’s a match. 💌 Contact information is only shared with mutual matches. 🧍 Coming alone? Absolutely. You don’t need to know anyone beforehand. The structured format is there to make meeting people easier, including if you’re shy, introverted, or not into approaching strangers at a bar. 💛 Can’t comfortably afford €20? Soli tickets are available. Request one in the comments when registering — no explanation or justification needed. 🤝 Consent, boundaries and mutual respect are essential. A conversation or flirtation never creates an obligation to share contact details or meet again. Discriminatory or harassing behaviour is not welcome. ♿ Step-free access · accessible seating & toilet · service animals welcome. Please note that simultaneous conversations can mean significant background noise. 📝 Register via the link in bio/event page. Come as you are and see who you click with. 💘

candidateAudit.text: What might consciousness smell like? Is it possible to sense interdependencies? Would you like to experience your embeddedness in the world? The SΫS SPACE prototype by artists duo MUELLER-DIVJAK opens its doors for two afternoons in September, inviting you for a one-of-a-kind experience, an exclusive multisensory trail of resonating with and better understanding of living systems. ⚡⚡⚡Currently all individual time slots are taken, but you can sign up for the waiting list! Find the link in our bio! Exclusive one-hour slot for a fascinating journey into your senses and search for a being that knows and feels everything about connectedness and interdependence. The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who is working at the AIL with international artists and systems scientists on the FWF/PEEK project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenographies for Systems Awareness (Project lead: Mag. Alexandra Graupner; University of Applied Arts), is devoted to creating experiential multisensory spaces – the so called SΫS SPACEs – that help enhancing systems awareness through special sensory cues. Such allowing for coping resiliently with the complex interrelations and interactions that shape our world and all our lives. mueller_divjak dieangewandte

candidateAudit.text: The Unsafe+Sounds festival, held annually in Vienna, returns in September with a kaleidoscopic program, offering a multifaceted glimpse into the contemporary music scene and AIL is delighted to once again host one event in the program. unsafeandsounds AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna (Free entry) Overview: 18:30 Panel Discussion, unsafe+sounds in cooperation with the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures (University of Applied Arts Vienna) weibel.institute Affective Histories Timotheus Vermeulen and Christian Höller in conversation with Sophie Publig History is never simply given. It is made through the scales and materials by which the past becomes legible: from sweeping narratives and historical events to gestures, sounds, images, technical infrastructures, and seemingly minor traces SOPHIE PUBLIG is a Senior Scientist researching digital ecosystems. Based at the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, she navigates the intricate networks of online territories. TIMOTHEUS VERMEULEN is Professor of Media, Culture and Society at the University of Oslo and joint director of the Media Aesthetics Research Group. He was a visiting scholar in Art History at Harvard in 2023–24 and will serve as joint Principal Investigator on a project on the politics of tone at the Centre for Advanced Study in Oslo in 2027–28. CHRISTIAN HÖLLER is editor and co-publisher of springerin – Hefte für Gegenwartskunst. Since 2024 he is head of the department Cross Disciplinary Strategies at the University of Applied Arts Vienna. cro

candidateAudit.text: Looking for a relaxed way to spend your Saturday evening? Join us for (board) Gayme Night at Villa Vida Café, an evening of games, queer community, and meeting people. 📅 Saturday, 5 September ⏰ 18:00–late 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna Whether you’re a board game enthusiast, an occasional player, or have absolutely no idea what you’re doing, you’re welcome. 🃏♟️🎲 Come by yourself, with a friend, with a partner, or with a whole group. Arriving alone is completely normal—you can join a table and meet people through playing rather than having to make endless small talk. 🌈 What to expect: ✨ Board and card games ✨ Beginner-friendly atmosphere ✨ Queer community & new faces ✨ No need to be competitive ✨ Stay for one game or the whole evening ✨ Bring a favourite game if you want — or simply show up 🌍 Languages: We’re a multilingual community. English and German are commonly spoken, but there’s no required event language. Tables can play in whatever language works for everyone involved. ♿ Accessibility: Villa Vida Café has step-free access and an accessible toilet. The café is non-smoking indoors. Please keep in mind that several games and conversations may happen at once, so the space can become lively and noisy.

candidateAudit.text: Wer meint, Karfiol sei langweilig, hat ihn noch nie im Ofen geröstet und in eine Tortilla gewickelt. 🌮🔥 Außen leicht knusprig, innen weich und mit der perfekten Würze versehen, wird das Gemüse hier zum echten Star. ⭐️ Zutaten | Santa Maria Mini Tortillas | Santa Maria Taco Seasoning Mix | Santa Maria Taco Sauce | Paprika | Karfiol | Frisches Rotkraut | Feta | Frischer Koriander | Limettenspalten | Etwas Olivenöl | Salz | Zucker oder Apfelessig Zubereitung Den Rotkohl sehr fein hobeln, mit etwas Salz, einer Prise Zucker und frischem Limettensaft kräftig durchkneten und 10 bis 15 Minuten ziehen lassen. Hyperpop is known for pushing pop and electronic music beyond their usual boundaries. It can be bright, distorted, playful, chaotic, melodic, bass-heavy, or all of those things within the same track. What Is Day DJ at Villa Vida? Day DJ at Villa Vida Café is a regular series that gives local DJs space to share their sound in a daytime setting. The series focuses on new talent, experimentation, and community. Rather than putting DJs exclusively into a late-night club environment, Day DJ creates an accessible daytime space where artists can build sets, explore ideas, and connect with an audience. At the same time, the format is deliberately relaxed. You can come specifically for the music, meet friends for a drink, work from the café, or stay for the entire set. candidateAudit.text: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developing the project's multisensory scenography – the so-called SΫS SPACE. Aim of the Summer Studio is to prepare the prototype of the scenography, which will be established at the AIL in June 2027 as the centerpiece of the final exhibition of the PEEK project ’SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS — Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness.’ The SΫS SPACE facilitates a physical experience of one's own embededdness within living systems, within complex interrelationships – within a greater whole. It paves the way for relational sensing and thinking – an embodied systems awareness, that can help in coping with complexity, challenges, and uncertainties, and in making good decisions towards sustainable futures. It deliberately reduces the dominance of the sense of sight, placing the emphasis instead on smell, touch, and hearing. Numerous scientists, as well as invited artists, politicians, journalists, children, senior citizens, curators, cultural workers, educators, and teenagers are individually guided through the immersive environment by Jeanette Müller and Paul Divjak and share their responses in photo-based reflections and semi-structured interviews. Their feedback directly informs the prototype. Save the date! 14 and 15 Sep 2026 The SΫS SPACE will open to the public in individual time slots for an exclusive multisensory experience. candidateAudit.text: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to connect with an audience. Join drag artist DaDa JV for an interactive workshop exploring the art of storytelling through drag and performance. Together, you’ll look at how movement, music, character, costume, emotion, and stage presence work together to create performances that leave a lasting impact. This workshop is open to performers of all experience levels, from those taking their first steps into drag to seasoned artists looking to deepen their creative practice. Participants are encouraged to bring ideas, works in progress, or simply their curiosity. Together we’ll explore: • Finding your unique performance voice • Building a story through movement and music • Connecting authentically with an audience • Using drag as a tool for self expression and community • Developing confidence on stage Expect a welcoming, collaborative environment where experimentation is encouraged and every participant’s perspective is valued. Event Details Saturday, August 29 4:00 PM Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna This workshop is donation based. Give what you can. No one will be turned away for lack of funds. Come ready to learn, share, and discover new ways to bring your story to life on stage.

candidateAudit.text: Die perfekte Balance aus feiner Milde und herzhafter Würze. 🌯🌱 Wer sagt, dass Burritos immer schwer sein müssen? Diese Kombination beweist, wie genial cremiger Ziegenkäse mit einer würzigen Bohnen-Basis und einer frischen Note harmoniert. Ein unkompliziertes vegetarisches Gericht, das im Handumdrehen gerollt ist und sich genauso gut unterwegs wie entspannt auf der Couch genießen lässt. Deine Zutaten | Santa Maria Tortilla Large | Santa Maria Burrito Seasoning Mix | Santa Maria Taco Sauce (Mild oder Medium) | 1 Dose Kidney-Bohnen | Gekochter Reis (z.B. Basmati) | Ziegenkäse oder Ziegenfrischkäse | Avocado | Walnüsse oder Nüsse deiner Wahl | Frischer Blattspinat oder Sprossen So geht's: Die Bohnen kurz in einer Pfanne erwärmen und mit dem Burrito Seasoning Mix fein würzen. Die Avocado in Würfel schneiden und die Walnüsse grob hacken. Die Tortilla kurz im Ofen anwärmen. Danach mittig mit dem gekochten Reis, den gewürzten Bohnen, Ziegenkäse, den Avocadowürfeln und den gehackten Walnüssen belegen. Mit der Taco Sauce abrunden und final noch den Blattspinat dazugeben. Die Seiten der Tortilla einklappen, von unten her straff aufrollen und fest in Papier oder Folie wickeln. Kombinierst du Ziegenkäse öfter in herzhaften Wraps oder ist das für dich noch eine neue Entdeckung? 👇 #santamaria #santamariamoment

candidateAudit.text: Looking for a relaxed evening of games and great company? Join Gayme Night Vienna at Villa Vida Café for a free community board game night where everyone is welcome. Whether you’re an experienced strategist, a casual player, or completely new to board games, Gayme Night is all about meeting people, sharing laughs, and enjoying a welcoming queer space. Bring your favourite game or choose from our growing collection of board and card games. Come with friends or come on your own—there’s always a table to join. Event Details 📅 Date: Friday, 29 August 🕕 Time: 18:00–21:00 📍 Location: Villa Vida Café, Vienna 💸 Entry: Free No registration is required. Simply drop by whenever you’d like during the evening. What to Expect at Gayme Night At Gayme Night Vienna, you’ll find: * A relaxed and welcoming atmosphere * Classic and modern board games * Card games and party games * Opportunities to meet new people * Delicious drinks and food available throughout the evening * A community space where everyone is welcome Whether you enjoy cooperative adventures, competitive strategy games, quick party games, or social deduction, there’s something for every play style. Who Can Join? Gayme Night Vienna is open to everyone. Villa Vida Café is a queer community café that welcomes people of all genders, sexual orientations, identities, backgrounds, and experience levels. Whether it’s your first visit or you’re already part of the community, you’ll find a friendly and inclusive space. Come solo, bring a partner, invite friends, or meet new people during the evening. candidateAudit.text: Over the past season, every spin, every step, and every dance has made a real difference. 💜 Thanks to your generosity, Queer Salsa Wien has raised over €850 for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund (QVMAF) this year already. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund provides one-off emergency microgrants to queer people in Vienna experiencing unexpected financial hardship. Whether someone is struggling to pay rent, buy groceries, cover medical costs, or get through another crisis, these grants help community members when they need it most. A huge thank you to the incredible Queer Salsa Wien team for organising these classes, and to everyone who has danced, donated, volunteered, and supported this initiative. Every donation, no matter the size, helps build a stronger community based on solidarity and mutual care. Queer Salsa classes will be back at Villa Vida in October but in the meantime you can join their outdoor classes and parties. Follow queersalsawien for information. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund is an initiative started by hint.wien and villavidacafe. If you’d like to learn more about the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund or make a donation, visit queervienna.at. See you on the dance floor soon. 💃🏽🕺🏿❤️ 💜 Thank you, queersalsawien ! Over €850 raised for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund in 2026—thank you to everyone who danced and donated. QVMAF provides emergency microgrants to queer people in Vienna facing unexpected financial hardship. Learn more or support the fund at queervienna.at

candidateAudit.text: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. Across these artistic approaches, [REVERBERATED] invites visitors to consider memory not as something simply preserved, but as something continuously produced through interactions between bodies, technologies, and environments. The exhibition thus explores how the past continues to reverberate within the systems of the present. With contributions by: Agustina Belén Agüero, Lobna Awidat, Phin Anibal, Rimon Alyagon Darr, Ronnie Danaher, Tatiana Del Valle, Hasti Ghasedi, Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz, Hanna Hofmann, Tal Horesh, Mauritius Itzinger, Laura Isselhorst, Dina Karaman, Moritz Klarer, Anna Buchner, Leonard Otterbein, David Ristić, Rajarshi Sarkar, Agnes Schyberg, Aryan Shahabian, Majedeh Shahvelayati, Mehrta Shirzadian, Pauline Simon, Laura Chalabi, People of Soil Photos: Lea Dörl

candidateAudit.title: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafi
candidateAudit.text: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafik In collaborative drawing, two people share a single pen – the line becomes a space of negotiation. A play between control and letting go. Who leads – and when? Impulse meets resistance, conviction meets empathy. Not always a conversation, but always an understanding – a dance on paper. These and other experiments are part of the course “Drawing: Here & Now” by Simon Goritschnig, in which students of the department Drawing and Printmaking explore various qualities of drawing beyond observational study. In the project “Reflex,” these experimental setups are set against observational drawing. Students draw in the cashier hall of the former Postsparkasse, intuitively picking up details from architecture and space, as well as situations of coming together: conversations, movements, gazes. In this process, it becomes visible how public and social space is visually probed and explored. The focus lies on reflection — with, through, and within drawing. With contributions by: Andrea Vairelles, Anna Marino, Beth Sorby, Emilia Schönwiese, Flora Schmid, Hannah Horn, Henriette Sonntag, Leo Hasslinger, Maria Lutkova, Max Offergeld, Nikolaus Kohout, Sophie Schweizer, Anija S Dartizio, Timo Pfeifer, Vera Kügel AIL in cooperation with the department Drawing and Printmaking and Simon Goritschnig Image: Henriette Sonntag Design: Atelier Dreibholz Concept Postcard Editions and Production: Eva Weber

candidateAudit.title: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes
candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes a quiet declaration of care, resistance, and return. Here, the body is reclaimed as homeland, shaped by experience rather than imposed borders. A performance unfolding through turmeric as healing material and the body as living territory. The work is rooted in a deep commitment to women’s health and critical scientific perspectives, engaging forms of embodied knowledge that have long been ignored or erased. The body becomes both evidence and memory, offering its own geography as a space of protection, defiance, and belonging. The performance is adapted to each site, responding to the spatial and contextual conditions of different venues. Mehrta Shirzadian is a performance and multimedia artist and artistic ­researcher working at the intersection of art and science. With a background in molecular biology, mathematics, and computer science, she creates participatory works exploring microbial life, sound, and bodily ecologies, addressing embodiment, agency, and the politics of representation. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alt
candidateAudit.text: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alternative investment platform that explores the cultural, economic, and emotional afterlife of the collapse of René Benko’s SIGNA empire. Through NFTs, merchandise, video works, and performative sales strategies, the project examines how value is produced through speculation, narrative, and collective belief. Originally developed through public interventions, the project was expanded through a student take over by Digitale Kunst. This exhibition presents new project strands developed by the students: an NFT series reflecting on financial dependency, a merchandise collection appropriating the aesthetics of startup culture and luxury branding, and a series of short-form videos combining influencer culture, promotional performance, and social commentary. Operating at the intersection of installation, performance, and participatory fiction, Renés Collapse Collection invites visitors to engage directly with the mechanisms of speculation, value production, and collapse. A project by by Zora Hünermann and Jakob Margit With contributions by: Ulrike Fritzsche, Koschka Cosmo Keye, Juarez Suarez, Ghanishka Kedar, Sei Jeung, Ghazal Naeimi, Dongjoo Kim, Jazzmin, Margherita Pruneti, Nicolás Henao Bonnet, Roma Bogdanov, and Grisha Terno.

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:30 Pickle Collective Performance by Laura Chalabi _chalaura_ In the participatory performance, the pickled vegetables from the installation Pickle will be taken out of a few jars, while the prose text on the jars will be recited. Afterwards, the pickled vegetables will be eaten together. Visitors are invited to bring foods with which they would like to eat the pickled vegetables. Laura Chalabi is a multidisciplinary artist, mathematician and political activist. Her artistic practice revolves around storytelling, whether through mixed-media installations, text, or explorations of the expressive and tactile potential of materials. Her work reflects an ongoing interest in identity, post-colonial perspectives on heritage, and the subtle contradictions and longings that define human existence. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A performance and poem by Carla Schwering and Timna Lugstein from by the department of Institute of Fine Arts & Media Art – Photography (Sophie Thun) The phrase "Schreiben wir uns zusammen" that on the surface means something like “let’s write to each other again in more detail” actually implies a postponement. In the performance, the artists type excerpts from their shared chat history in a poetic arrangement on two typewriters facing each other – messages in which they attempt to get closer to one another. The time and effort spent cancelling meet ups, for which there is supposedly no capacity is made visible. With the postcards created for the performance, visitors can reconnect with a long-lost friend. On the occasion of Angewandte Festival AIL hosts a selection of performances and installations in the cashier hall and the current exhibition will have more activations. We will give you an overview, step by step AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna

candidateAudit.title: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 Jul 2026, 15:30 Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) Performance by Leonard Otterbein leona
candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 Jul 2026, 15:30 Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) Performance by Leonard Otterbein leonard.ottb The audio performance Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) explores how sound can model processes of memory formation and transformation. Layered oscillations and brief sound textures repeat with phase shifts, gradually overlapping and partially canceling each other out, much like the traces in an overwritten manuscript. The work is inspired by memory research on reconsolidation – in which recalling an event alters its stored form – and its cultural studies counterpart, reconstructivity. The piece is composed of multiple layers of sound that continuously overlap anew, attempting to cancel each other out in the process. In this process, however, the layers are never completely erased, so that fragments of the preceding states always remain Leonard Otterbein is a sound artist and composer with a background in ecology and ecotoxicology, where he studied mixture effects of agricultural pesticides and nanoparticles. His work spans instrumental and electroacoustic composition, examining perceptual thresholds. He works with psychoacoustic effects and approaches sound as spatial and sculptural material shaped by its relation to space. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsp
candidateAudit.text: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsparkasse as part of Angewandte Festival! 'LIMINAL TRACES. Celebrating Acoustic Ecologies' is a dynamic sound lecture that understands the acoustic world as a phenomenon of resonance, shaped by connectedness and interaction. Through the live-curated interplay of field recordings, physical and digital artefacts, the performance traces sonic imprints deeply embedded in our collective memory, presenting them as a new listening experience. Developed within SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS at the AIL, this solar performance explores the intersections of sound, pop history and solar energy, celebrating concept, improvisation and the (unexpected) emergent. The performance ends when the energy collected by the mobile solar unit runs out. — The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who conceived and initiated SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS, is working since 2023 at AIL with international artists and systems scientists to form experiential spaces by artistic means (scenographies) and to create sensory impressions that help us to better understand and resonate with living systems. During the project essential principles of living systems are transformed into olfactory, auditory and tactile artworks / artefacts and used experimentally. Team: Jeanette Müller, Paul Divjak, Alexandra Graupner, Anna-Maria Irgang

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 July 2026, 15:00 Hypervigilant Performance by Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz iukumukui Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory artscience.ak Constant vigilance can develop as a response to racial discrimination and transgenerational trauma, allowing potential threats to be recognized in advance. This fight-or-flight state activates the nervous system and can lead to chronic muscle tension and bruxism. Teeth grinding occurs as a way of coping with stress during sleep, often driven by societal expectations to suppress fear or anger. Hypervigilant addresses this suppressed anger. Aluminum teeth suspended from the ceiling form a space similar to a cage that oscillates between protection and exposure. Shaped as gong-like instruments, the oversized representation of the artist’s bite is set into vibration during a sound performance to release embodied pressure and reduce tension in the nervous system. Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz’s practice centers on suppressed experiences expressed in imagined worlds. Through performative sculptures and installations, she examines spatial dynamics and power structures. Addressing socio-political themes such as racism, sexism, gender, and sexuality, she builds subconscious environments using reference-based objects and constructions in combination with text and sound. candidateAudit.title: As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Performance by Laura Oyuela and Ádám Salomvári (students of the department Cross-Disciplinary Strategies) Rocks, I mean; - Stars is a
candidateAudit.text: As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Performance by Laura Oyuela and Ádám Salomvári (students of the department Cross-Disciplinary Strategies) Rocks, I mean; - Stars is a sonic and spatial performance departing from text, soundscapes, spoken words and its physical surrounding. The piece works with analogies between black holes and human beings through low frequencies, orbital motion, and stretched time, shaping a field that gathers bodies into one another. The project investigates how perceptual, cognitive, and affective dynamics shape the experience of artistic performance in relation to contemporary conditions of subjectivity, particularly isolation and hyperproductivity. The performance is part of the Cross-Disciplinary Strategies Master’s program exhibition 2026. The work is realised with the technical support of ÆSR Lab, which has contributed to its sonic and spatial development. Photo: earthboundeva

candidateAudit.text: Nach unfassbaren 25, unheimlich schönen, sehr lehrreichen, extrem intensiven, manchmal furchtbar mühsamen, sehr feierlichen, fröhlichen, schrägen, überraschenden, ja oft auch feuchtfröhlichen, leider manchmal auch sehr traurigen, aber immer sehr menschlichen, stets emotionalen und letztendlich wunderbaren Jahren U.S.W., verlasse ich mein geliebtes Beisl nach einem 1/4 Jahrhundert. Nie hätte ich gedacht so lange dabeizusein und ich weiß nicht, ob ich es - mit heutigem Wissen - nochmal machen würde. Aber eines weiß ich: ich bin unendlich dankbar für die vielen Menschen, die ich hier kennenlernen durfte, für die vielen wertschätzenden, respektvollen, so tollen, lieben Gäste, die zu Freunden wurden und die mir so ans Herz gewachsen sind. Extrem dankbar bin ich meinen Wegbegleitern, von denen ich speziell Kerstin, Eva und Elisabeth DANKE sagen möchte, nicht zuletzt auch Reini..RIP. Danke, dass es euch gibt, danke, dass ihr mir auch zur Seite gestanden seid, wenns mal schwer war, auch mit mir persönlich. Danke an die extrem treuen Stammgäste. Ihr seid alle der Wahnsinn! ❤️❤️❤️❤️ Das U.S.W. wird weitergehen. Ich werde mich neuen Projekten widmen, davor mal alles verarbeiten und mal mein Telefon nachts abschalten. Kommt alle am 30.5. vorbei. Ich freu mich auf jeden von euch! Und alle die es nicht schaffen: Am 27.5. findet das letzte Quiz unter meiner "Regie" statt. Es wird mein etwa 1250. sein. 😱 Wer auch das nicht schafft, schaffts davor, dazwischen oder danach. Allen anderen: Danke, es war mir eine Ehre. Macht's gut! ❤️
